description: Returns one of the 99 Names of Allah by number (1-99) or by name: Arabic, transliteration, meaning, reflection and Quranic references. Quote the Arabic exactly.

locale.description: Locale for meaning + reflection. Defaults to "en".

name.description: Name input — Latin transliteration ('Al-Hakam'), Arabic ('الحكم'), or English meaning ('The Judge').

number.description: Number of the Name in the canonical list, 1-99.

name: get_name_of_allah
